name: Pyromancer Fiery Faith converts Spirit to spell crit rating (#1208)
contract: #1208: Fiery Faith 503913 effect 1 is aura 220 SPELL_AURA_MOD_RATING_FROM_STAT, misc 1024 (1 << CR_CRIT_SPELL = 10), miscB 4 (Spirit), bp 14 (15%). AuraEffect::HandleModRatingFromStat and Player::UpdateRating add 15% of Spirit to spell crit rating natively. The scenario asserts the rating rises after learning the passive (min 1: the exact floor(0.15 x Spirit) depends on the fixture's Spirit, which the scenario does not hard-code) and falls back when it is removed. Values from inv-group-8.md.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Spell crit rating before Fiery Faith
Fiery Faith grants spell crit rating from Spirit (15% of Spirit, at least 1)
Fiery Faith does not change Spirit itself
Removing Fiery Faith returns the rating
